title: Reset a forgotten Windows password or unlock an account
keywords: forgot my password,forgotten password,password expired,reset my password,account locked,locked out
resolution: Use the self-service portal at the login screen: select 'Forgot password', verify with your registered mobile number, and choose a new password of at least 14 characters. An account locked after five failed attempts unlocks automatically after 15 minutes. If you have no registered mobile number, reply to this message and the Identity & Access team will call you back.

title: Re-register MFA after changing phone
resolution: Sign in from a company laptop on the office network, open Security Info in the account portal, remove the old device and add the new phone by scanning the QR code in the authenticator app. If you no longer have access to any registered method, the Identity & Access team must verify your identity by video call before resetting MFA.

title: Clear a stuck print queue
keywords: print queue,stuck in the queue,printer offline,documents not printing,printing stuck
resolution: Open Settings > Printers, select the printer, choose 'Open print queue' and cancel all documents. Restart the laptop, then send one test page. If the printer still shows offline, check the printer display for a paper jam or error code and include that code in your reply.

title: Mailbox full warning in Outlook
keywords: mailbox full,mailbox is full,mailbox size,cannot send email quota
resolution: Empty Deleted Items, then run Tools > Mailbox Cleanup and archive items older than 12 months to the online archive. The quota is 50 GB
column6: the warning clears within one hour of dropping below 48 GB.

title: VPN keeps disconnecting
keywords: vpn disconnects,vpn keeps dropping,vpn drops,vpn disconnecting
resolution: Update the VPN client to the version published on the software portal, switch the connection profile from 'Auto' to 'Head Office TCP', and disable Wi-Fi power saving in Device Manager. If drops continue on the latest client, reply with the time of the last three disconnects so Network & Infrastructure can match them to gateway logs.

title: External monitor not detected on docking station
keywords: docking station,second monitor,external monitor,screen not detected,dock
resolution: Unplug the dock power for 30 seconds, reconnect the laptop using the USB-C port marked with the display icon, and press Windows+P to select 'Extend'. Install pending firmware updates from the software portal if the monitor is still not detected.

title: ERP month-end report export times out
keywords: report export,export times out,report timeout,export to excel
resolution: Large ERP report exports over 100,000 rows exceed the interactive timeout. Run the report with 'Execute in background', then collect the file from the spool list the next morning. This is a documented limitation, not an outage.

title: Guest Wi-Fi access for visitors
resolution: Reception issues daily guest Wi-Fi vouchers valid for 24 hours. For visits longer than one day, the host employee requests a multi-day voucher on the service portal under Network > Guest access.
